claim.text: A redaction save that flattens a region reads every /Properties dictionary the flattened page reached (its own /Resources, inline or as an object, a /Properties object it named, the /Resources it inherited from a /Pages node, also when its own /Resources resolves to null (R27-P2: PdfDoc::inherited, the renderer and the purge read a null-resolving inherited entry as absent), the /Resources a kept page received from its /Parent chain, the /Resources of every stream and Type 3 font it reached). Lead diagnosis DIAG-PRESS-R27: a dictionary no kept page reaches (its holder object is not reachable from any kept page) is purged exactly, every entry no BDC or DP operator of the content the usage analysis reads names is removed (inline dictionaries and references); a dictionary a kept page reaches (own or inherited, inline or as an object) is not edited. residual_in_region adds 1 (NotProven::ResidualInRegion, region_flattened false) for: an entry of a kept-page-reached dictionary that no kept content names whose inline property list holds /Alt /ActualText /E /T or /Lang; each property-list object that an unnamed entry of any reached dictionary names (one written inline in the replaced page or the emptied /Pages node included, R27-P1) and that the saved file still holds with one of those keys while no kept content names it; a reached dictionary whose usage is undetermined (unreadable scope content, incomplete analysis); a reached dictionary the purge cannot edit (stream or alias spelling) with an unnamed entry whose property list holds such text.; and (R28-P1, lead diagnosis DIAG-PRESS-R28, fail closed) each /Resources of a /Pages node of the flattened page's /Parent chain beyond the one it read (every node's when the page has its own /Resources; every node's after the nearest one with /Resources when it inherited) whose /Properties holds a property list with /Alt /ActualText /E /T or /Lang, named or not (a viewer that merges ancestor /Resources resolves the old page's names there; ISO 32000 nearest-only reading UNVERIFIED). Entries kept content names stay with their text (the R28-P1 ancestor rule counts regardless). With a flattened region, check_document also counts a /Type or /S past the reader's 16-hop bound, a stream with /N and /First read as an object stream whatever its /Type, object-stream bytes that are not white space, comments, header pairs or members, and structure shapes in the saved trailer.
